text:
sam: FYI customer 'acme-inc' reporting tool/invoke failing with validator errors during checkout flow. 422 body attached.

sam: Error returned -> "ValidationError: required property 'billing_profile.id' missing; order.items[0].quantity: expected integer but got string; additionalProperties: 'discount_code' not allowed"

sam: Payload we received:
```json
{
  "tool_name": "create_order",
  "billing_profile": {
    "email": "ops@acme.com"
  },
  "order": {
    "items": [ { "sku": "ABC-123", "quantity": "2" } ],
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "discount_code": "SPRINGSALE"
}
```

kevin: :eyes: @ada can you try to repro locally? suspect SDK sending discount_code at top-level plus quantity as string.

ada: Repro'd on my machine with SDK v1.4.2. Minimal repro: run curl below -> get same 422. Looks like client UI added discount_code as a free-form top-level field which violates function schema (additionalProperties=false). Also the web form sends quantity as a string.

ada: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/tool/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "tool_name": "create_order",
  "billing_profile": { "email": "ops@acme.com" },
  "order": { "items": [ { "sku": "ABC-123", "quantity": "2" } ], "currency": "USD" },
  "discount_code": "SPRINGSALE"
}'

qa-bot: Repro steps logged (run id: 2026-03-17-qa-009). Validator output snippet: 
```
function_schema: additionalProperties=false at /payload
required: ["billing_profile.id"] missing
order.items[0].quantity: type mismatch (string != integer)
```

sam: Customer blocked on checkout. I've opened support ticket CS-12873 and sent them a short workaround: strip discount_code and include billing_profile.id while we patch.

kevin: If schema change isn't desired, patch options: gateway-strip, SDK coercion, or UI validation. Which is fastest?

ada: Fastest: gateway-strip discount_code + SDK hotfix to coerce quantity -> int. I'll open PR for SDK and gateway rule. Patch ETA ~2 hours.

sam: Thanks. I'll update customer with workaround + ETA. Assigning eng-runtime if you need schema relax, but prefer not to.

kevin: ack. please paste PR link when ready and attach headers from failing request (auth scope, customer tenant).

sam: Will do. :thumbsup:
